sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_contract_clauses (tenantId,clauseName,clauseCategory,clauseHtml,sortOrder,isActive,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT :tenantId,:clauseName,NULLIF(:category,''),:clauseHtml,:sortOrder,:isActive,:userId,:userId2 FROM DUAL WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(:nameCheck),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:htmlCheck),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=:moduleTenant AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.configure' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=:roleTenant AND utr.isActive=1)
